summary: Trip.com Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an audit committee meeting scheduled for June 24, 2026 (Hong Kong time) to approve its Q1 2026 financial results, with the results to be published on June 25, 2026 (Hong Kong time) followed by a conference call. This filing is a routine notification of an earnings release date, containing no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or management changes. The company is simply scheduling standard board and investor communications. There are no deal terms, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics involved. This is a typical periodic reporting event with no event-driven investing angle.
